title: America's Hall, Geddes Hall and Planters Hotel
summary: Parker does not know the halls named.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: We were talking about dance halls. Did you have one? America's or something?
Have you ever heard of the America's Hall? I don't know what that was.
America's Hall. America's? Yeah. No, sir.
What about Geddes Hall? Did you ever hear anything about Geddes Hall?
I heard of it, but I never heard of it.
That's not in this neighborhood. No, ma'am.
Do you remember the Planters Hotel? Planters Hotel? Planters Hotel.
